missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Чай' is nominative as the subject. 'Этот' is the agreeing masculine determiner, and 'горячий' is the predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Чай' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; this inanimate masculine noun looks identical to the nominative. 'Зелёный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Чая' is the partitive genitive after 'чашку' to mean a cup of tea. 'Чашку' itself is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Чаю' is the dative form after 'к' to express adding to something. 'Сахар' is the accusative object of 'добавь'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Чаем' is instrumental after 'с' to mean served with tea. 'Пирог' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Чае' is the prepositional form after 'в' to mark location inside. 'Много сахара' uses the genitive of quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Чай' is nominative as the doer of 'остыл', which agrees in masculine gender. 'Давно' adds the time reference.
Strategic focus: Genitive partitive. 'Чаю' is the old partitive genitive in -у, still common with чай. 'Чашку' is the accusative object of 'хочешь'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Чаи' is the nominative plural meaning kinds of tea. 'Разные' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'в магазине' is prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Чай' is the accusative object of 'пью', identical to the nominative for this inanimate noun. 'Каждое утро' gives the routine.
